mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates through lower risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as valuation multiples expand without offsetting economic deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals persistent labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 500) and industrial production (INDPRO > 93.0) indicates accelerating demand momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days via improved earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST > 500 and INDPRO > 93.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession expansion, inflation exceeding 2.0% annualized (CPIAUCSL > 2.0%) signals imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through rising real yields and reduced equity attractiveness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0% during post-recession expansion, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0) indicates sustained economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated corporate earnings visibility and reduced recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 is positive, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls exceeding 130,000 (PAYEMS > 130,000) signals robust labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 130,000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.0% annualized) signal imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through yield curve steepening and equity valuation contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 94.0) in early-cycle expansion signals weakening supply chain momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced capital expenditure expectations and earnings revisions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 94.0 during early-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
